property_summary: For every caller and guessed block, after lockInGuess and then calling settle once when block.number > locked block, the reference C always clears guesses[caller].block to 0 (so a subsequent settle call without re-locking will revert due to guesses[caller].block == 0), whereas the mutant that removed the clearing leaves guesses[caller].block nonzero and allows a second settle call to proceed (and potentially re-pay) — the test fuzzes the caller and guess block choice and checks that a second settle call reverts on the reference but may succeed on the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the line that sets guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 with deleting that line (i.e., no reset), so the stored block remains unchanged after settle.
